content_sections.heading: Central Railway Teacher Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for Central Railway Teacher Recruitment 2026 must fulfil the required educational qualifications prescribed for the respective teaching post. Candidates applying for Primary Teacher posts should have passed 12th standard with at least 50% marks and D.Ed. (Two Years) along with CTET qualification.

rows.qualification: M.A. (English Literature as main subject) + B.Ed.
B.A. Hindi as subject in all three years + B.Ed. + CTET

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Central Railway Teacher Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates interested in Central Railway Teacher Vacancy 2026 need to attend the walk-in interview with the required documents. Download or obtain the prescribed application format. Fill in personal, educational and experience details. Attach required certificates and documents. Attend the interview on the respective date according to the post applied for. faq.question: Q1. What is Central Railway Teacher Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Central Railway Teacher Recruitment 2026 is a recruitment drive for engaging PGT, TGT and Primary Teachers on contract basis at Central Railway School Kalyan.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in Central Railway Teacher Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 17 teaching vacancies are available.

faq.question: Q3. What are the posts available in Central Railway Teacher Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The posts include Post Graduate Teacher (PGT), Trained Graduate Teacher (TGT) and Primary Teacher.

faq.question: Q4. What is the interview date for Central Railway Teacher Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interviews will be conducted from 19 August 2026 to 21 August 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of Central Railway Teachers?
faq.answer: The monthly remuneration ranges from ₹21,250 to ₹27,500 depending on the post.

faq.question: Q6. What is the qualification for Central Railway PGT posts?
faq.answer: Candidates require postgraduate qualification in the relevant subject along with B.Ed.

faq.question: Q7. What is the qualification for Central Railway TGT posts?
faq.answer: Candidates require graduation in the relevant subject along with B.Ed. and CTET wherever applicable.

faq.question: Q8. What is the age limit for Central Railway Teacher Recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 65 years as mentioned in the notification.
